comparison.controls: same causal features, action feasibility, hard resource reserve, forecast horizon and root score budget for all methods
comparison.primary: paired mean GOSPA in metres; also separate localization, missed/false, coverage, calibration, RF and exposure metrics
comparison.selection: minimum validation total loss across completed epochs; earliest tie; train all registered epochs
comparison.confirmation: freeze source, configuration, best-checkpoint hashes before opening confirmation worlds
comparison.failures: stop incomplete stage, preserve failed job and denominator, resume same task; never replace seed
comparison.timing: concurrent host throughput; no isolated-latency superiority claim

fidelity: planar measurement-level simulation with analytic propagation/detection models; device design assumptions, no new hardware calibration
